name: social-frame
title: Social frame
line: Your clip pulls back into a post card, a phone, a fan of phones or the middle of a grid, and keeps playing there
card: Your clip shrinks into a phone and plays
say: put my video in a phone
make it look like a post card
show it as a fan of phones
put me in the middle of my grid
frame my clip like a reel

askeditor.what: Put my clip in a phone frame
askeditor.why: swap the frame, retype the name and the caption, and move when it pulls back on the canvas, without rendering again
